title: Street Lamp/Light Maintenance
description: Use this service request to report maintenance needed for a street light or highway lighting (including high mast and underpass lighting). The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 10 business days. Due to requiring lane closures, you may experience delays on maintenance of highway lighting. **Please report street lights that are mounted on wooden poles directly to Oncor 1-888-313-4747 or Click Here **

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for street, pedestrian, or highway lighting maintenance.
actions.why: To report maintenance needed for street, pedestrian, highway, or freeway lighting, including high mast and underpass lights. The 311 request form covers a bulb that is out, a light cycling on and off, a knocked-down pole, a row of lights out, or another lighting problem; a pole number can be supplied if available.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Street Lamp/Light Maintenance" requests is not the route for lights on wooden poles, traffic signals, school flashers, or warning flashers. If the issue concerns a traffic signal, school flasher, or warning flasher, then call 311 by phone instead of submitting a 311 request online. If the street light is mounted on a wooden pole, then report it directly to Oncor.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Street Lamp/Light Maintenance"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Street Lamp/Light Maintenance"

actions.tagline: Report a wooden-pole street light to Oncor.
actions.why: For maintenance of a street light mounted on a wooden pole. The description for "Street Lamp/Light Maintenance" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs this specific pole type to Oncor by phone or website.
